vsm1.4:21.1: Idāni sabbaṃ bhāvanāvidhānaṃ aparihāpentena bhāvetabboti ettha
vsm1.4:21.2: ayaṃ pathavīkasiṇaṃ ādiṃ katvā sabbakammaṭṭhānavasena vitthārakathā hoti.
vsm1.4:22.5: katāya vā akatāya vā pathaviyā nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:22.7: ‘‘Pathavīkasiṇaṃ uggaṇhanto pathaviyaṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhāti kate vā akate vā
vsm1.4:22.13: So taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ karoti, sūpadhāritaṃ upadhāreti, suvavatthitaṃ vavatthapeti.
vsm1.4:22.14: So taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ katvā sūpadhāritaṃ upadhāretvā suvavatthitaṃ vavatthapetvā
vsm1.4:22.21: So vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī’’ti.
vsm1.4:23.1: Tattha yena atītabhavepi sāsane vā isipabbajjāya vā pabbajitvā
vsm1.4:23.4: akatāya pathaviyā kasitaṭṭhāne vā khalamaṇḍale vā nimittaṃ uppajjati,
vsm1.4:23.6: Tassa kirāyasmato kasitaṭṭhānaṃ olokentassa taṃṭhānappamāṇameva nimittaṃ udapādi.
vsm1.4:24.2: tena ācariyasantike uggahitakammaṭṭhānavidhānaṃ avirādhetvā cattāro kasiṇadose pariharantena kasiṇaṃ kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:24.5: gaṅgāvahe mattikāsadisāya aruṇavaṇṇāya mattikāya kasiṇaṃ kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:24.6: Tañca kho vihāramajjhe sāmaṇerādīnaṃ sañcaraṇaṭṭhāne na kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:24.7: Vihārapaccante pana paṭicchannaṭṭhāne pabbhāre vā paṇṇasālāya vā
vsm1.4:25.1: Tatra saṃhārimaṃ catūsu daṇḍakesu pilotikaṃ vā cammaṃ vā kaṭasārakaṃ vā bandhitvā
vsm1.4:25.2: tattha apanītatiṇamūlasakkharakathalikāya sumadditāya mattikāya vuttappamāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ limpetvā kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:25.4: Tatraṭṭhakaṃ bhūmiyaṃ padumakaṇṇikākārena khāṇuke ākoṭetvā vallīhi vinandhitvā kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:25.7: uparibhāge suparisodhitāya aruṇavaṇṇāya mattikāya vidatthicaturaṅgulavitthāraṃ vaṭṭaṃ kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:25.8: Etadeva hi pamāṇaṃ sandhāya ‘‘suppamattaṃ vā sarāvamattaṃ vā’’ti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:26.2: rukkhapāṇikā visabhāgavaṇṇaṃ samuṭṭhapeti. Tasmā taṃ aggahetvā pāsāṇapāṇikāya ghaṃsetvā
vsm1.4:26.5: kasiṇamaṇḍalato aḍḍhateyyahatthantare padese paññatte vidatthicaturaṅgulapādake suatthate pīṭhe nisīditabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:26.6: Tato dūratare nisinnassa hi kasiṇaṃ na upaṭṭhāti,
vsm1.4:26.8: Uccatare nisinnena gīvaṃ onamitvā oloketabbaṃ hoti, nīcatare jaṇṇukāni rujanti.
vsm1.4:27.5: ‘‘ayaṃ dāni sā sabbabuddha paccekabuddha ariyasāvakehi paṭipannā nekkhammapaṭipadā’’ti paṭipattiyā sañjātagāravena
vsm1.4:27.6: ‘‘addhā imāya paṭipadāya pavivekasukharasassa bhāgī bhavissāmī’’ti ussāhaṃ janayitvā
vsm1.4:27.7: samena ākārena cakkhūni ummīletvā nimittaṃ gaṇhantena bhāvetabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:28.7: Tasmā ādāsatale mukhanimittadassinā viya samenākārena cakkhūni ummīletvā nimittaṃ gaṇhantena bhāvetabbaṃ,
vsm1.4:29.4: nissayasavaṇṇaṃ katvā ussadavasena paṇṇattidhamme cittaṃ paṭṭhapetvā manasi kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:29.7: yamicchati, yadassa saññānukūlaṃ hoti, taṃ vattabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:29.8: Apica pathavīti etadeva nāmaṃ pākaṭaṃ, tasmā pākaṭavaseneva pathavī pathavīti bhāvetabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:29.10: Yāva uggahanimittaṃ nuppajjati, tāva kālasatampi kālasahassampi tato bhiyyopi eteneva nayena bhāvetabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:30.2: yadā nimīletvā āvajjantassa ummīlitakāle viya āpāthamāgacchati,
vsm1.4:30.4: Tassa jātakālato paṭṭhāya na tasmiṃ ṭhāne nisīditabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:30.5: Attano vasanaṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā tattha nisinnena bhāvetabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:30.6: Pādadhovanapapañcaparihāratthaṃ panassa ekapaṭalikupāhanā ca kattaradaṇḍo ca icchitabbo.
vsm1.4:30.7: Athānena sace taruṇo samādhi kenacideva asappāyakāraṇena nassati,
vsm1.4:31.5: Tatrāyaṃ purimassa ca uggahanimittassa imassa ca viseso,
vsm1.4:31.7: paṭibhāganimittaṃ thavikato nihatādāsamaṇḍalaṃ viya sudhotasaṅkhathālaṃ viya valāhakantarā nikkhantacandamaṇḍalaṃ viya meghamukhe balākā viya uggahanimittaṃ padāletvā nikkhantamiva tato sataguṇaṃ sahassaguṇaṃ suparisuddhaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.4:31.8: Tañca kho neva vaṇṇavantaṃ, na saṇṭhānavantaṃ.
vsm1.4:31.13: Uppannakālato ca panassa paṭṭhāya nīvaraṇāni vikkhambhitāneva honti,
vsm1.4:32.1: Duvidho hi samādhi upacārasamādhi ca appanāsamādhi ca.
vsm1.4:32.2: Dvīhākārehi cittaṃ samādhiyati upacārabhūmiyaṃ vā paṭilābhabhūmiyaṃ vā.
vsm1.4:32.3: Tattha upacārabhūmiyaṃ nīvaraṇappahānena cittaṃ samāhitaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:33.3: aṅgānaṃ athāmajātattā, yathā nāma daharo kumārako ukkhipitvā ṭhapiyamāno punappunaṃ bhūmiyaṃ patati, evameva upacāre uppanne cittaṃ kālena nimittamārammaṇaṃ karoti, kālena bhavaṅgamotarati.
vsm1.4:33.5: tesaṃ thāmajātattā, yathā nāma balavā puriso āsanā vuṭṭhāya divasampi tiṭṭheyya, evameva appanāsamādhimhi uppanne cittaṃ sakiṃ bhavaṅgavāraṃ chinditvā kevalampi rattiṃ kevalampi divasaṃ tiṭṭhati, kusalajavanapaṭipāṭivaseneva pavattatīti.
vsm1.4:34.1: Tatra yadetaṃ upacārasamādhinā saddhiṃ paṭibhāganimittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa uppādanaṃ nāma atidukkaraṃ.
vsm1.4:34.2: Tasmā sace teneva pallaṅkena taṃ nimittaṃ vaḍḍhetvā appanaṃ adhigantuṃ sakkoti, sundaraṃ.
vsm1.4:34.3: No ce sakkoti, athānena taṃ nimittaṃ appamattena cakkavattigabbho viya rakkhitabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:34.4:
Evañhi –
Nimittaṃ rakkhato laddha-parihāni na vijjati;
vsm1.4:35.2: Āvāso gocaro bhassaṃ, puggalo bhojanaṃ utu;
vsm1.4:35.4:
Sappāye satta sevetha, evañhi paṭipajjato;
Nacireneva kālena, hoti kassaci appanā.
vsm1.4:36.5: asamāhitañca cittaṃ na samādhiyati, ayaṃ asappāyo.
vsm1.4:36.6: Yattha nimittaṃ uppajjati ceva thāvarañca hoti,
vsm1.4:36.10: Tasmā yasmiṃ vihāre bahū āvāsā honti,
vsm1.4:36.11: tattha ekamekasmiṃ tīṇi tīṇi divasāni vasitvā
vsm1.4:36.12: yatthassa cittaṃ ekaggaṃ hoti, tattha vasitabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:36.14: tambapaṇṇidīpamhi cūḷanāgaleṇe vasantā tattheva kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā pañcasatā bhikkhū arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.
vsm1.4:36.15: Sotāpannādīnaṃ pana aññattha ariyabhūmiṃ patvā tattha arahattappattānañca gaṇanā natthi.
vsm1.4:37.1: Gocaragāmo pana yo senāsanato uttarena vā dakkhiṇena vā
vsm1.4:38.1: Bhassanti dvattiṃsatiracchānakathāpariyāpannaṃ asappāyaṃ, tañhissa nimittantaradhānāya saṃvattati.
vsm1.4:39.2: yaṃ nissāya asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādhiyati,
vsm1.4:39.6: So hi taṃ kaddamodakamiva acchaṃ udakaṃ malīnameva karoti,
vsm1.4:40.1: Bhojanaṃ pana kassaci madhuraṃ, kassaci ambilaṃ sappāyaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:40.2: Utupi kassaci sīto, kassaci uṇho sappāyo hoti.
vsm1.4:40.3: Tasmā yaṃ bhojanaṃ vā utuṃ vā sevantassa phāsu hoti,
vsm1.4:40.6: taṃ bhojanaṃ so ca utu sappāyo.
vsm1.4:40.7: Itaraṃ bhojanaṃ itaro ca utu asappāyo.
vsm1.4:41.1: Iriyāpathesupi kassaci caṅkamo sappāyo hoti, kassaci sayanaṭṭhānanisajjānaṃ aññataro.
vsm1.4:41.2: Tasmā taṃ āvāsaṃ viya tīṇi divasāni upaparikkhitvā
vsm1.4:41.3: yasmiṃ iriyāpathe asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādhiyati,
vsm1.4:41.4: samāhitaṃ vā thirataraṃ hoti, so sappāyo.
vsm1.4:41.6: Iti imaṃ sattavidhaṃ asappāyaṃ vajjetvā sappāyaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
